goal: Advanced Conversational State Machine & Multi-Turn Slot Filling Engine
context: Track sales negotiation slots (product_sku, size, color, quantity, shipping_address, phone_number) across multiple chat turns. When customer provides partial info, bot intelligently probes for the next missing slot before triggering human handoff when ready to close.
requirements: Build MultiTurnSlotTracker persisting state in conversation context
Extract and validate size, color, quantity, and address slots from Vietnamese chat
Guide SalesAgent to ask specifically for the next unfilled required slot
Trigger HOT handoff once core order slots are fulfilled
acceptance_criteria: Validates 3-turn and 4-turn multi-turn ordering flow where bot systematically collects missing slots and triggers order confirmation handoff
